title: 阿帕契案例與旋翼機原理
summary: 以公開案例認識旋翼機，透過非飛行模型學習升力、傳動概念、振動及適航安全。
summaryEn: Use public context and non-flying models to study rotorcraft lift, transmission concepts, vibration and airworthiness safety.
scope: 旋翼機物理與安全教育；不含武器、瞄準、軍用性能設計、飛行操作或真機組裝。
scopeEn: Rotorcraft physics and safety education only; excludes weapons, targeting, military-performance design, flight operations and operational aircraft assembly.

steps.title: 辨識旋翼與機身
steps.objective: 完成「辨識旋翼與機身」的概念模型與工程檢核。
steps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for identify rotor and fuselage.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 旋翼同時影響升力與機體反作用，不能只把它當作向上的風扇。
knowledge.textEn: A rotor affects lift and airframe reaction, rather than acting merely as an upward fan.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 在示意圖上標出旋翼、機身與反作用方向。
knowledge.textEn: Mark rotor, fuselage and reaction directions on a schematic.

steps.check: 在示意圖上標出旋翼、機身與反作用方向。
steps.checkEn: Mark rotor, fuselage and reaction directions on a schematic.

quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「辨識旋翼與機身」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains identify rotor and fuselage?
options: 旋翼同時影響升力與機體反作用，不能只把它當作向上的風扇。
能源經動力來源與傳動到旋翼，其中每一段都存在效率損失。
靜態模型可展示機械關係，而真實飛行需要獨立適航驗證。
optionsEn: A rotor affects lift and airframe reaction, rather than acting merely as an upward fan.
Energy passes through power source and transmission to the rotor, with losses at each stage.
A static model illustrates mechanical relationships; actual flight needs independent airworthiness validation.
quiz.explanation: 旋翼同時影響升力與機體反作用，不能只把它當作向上的風扇。
quiz.explanationEn: A rotor affects lift and airframe reaction, rather than acting merely as an upward fan.
